# Shruti 1.4.38
- Shruti now stays quiet in the background. With its mixer closed it uses almost no processor time, so your Mac stays cool and other apps keep the power they need. - Leaving another window open, such as the update window or Settings, no longer keeps a hidden mixer redrawing four times a second. Before, this could keep one processor core fully busy for hours. - The menu-bar icon still changes the moment something changes: mute, Bypass All, an app starting to play, or the volume. - The mixer shows the latest levels the instant you open it.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later; Apple silicon and Intel. Existing settings, app arrangements and window preferences are retained.
